intro.title: Growing Opportunities, Together
intro.subtitle: ROOT brings together youth organizations from 6 countries to tackle the challenges of rural decline by empowering young people with knowledge, networks, and tools for sustainable rural development.
intro.f1_d: Promoting environmentally conscious approaches to rural development and community building.
intro.f2_d: Equipping young people with the skills and confidence to drive change in their communities.
intro.f3_d: Connecting rural youth across 6 countries to share experiences and best practices.
intro.f4_d: Exploring creative solutions to rural challenges through agritourism, digital tools, and entrepreneurship.

about.hero_sub: ROOT – Rural Opportunities and Outreach for Tomorrow is an Erasmus+ funded youth project that brings together six organizations from different countries to address the challenges and unlock the potential of rural communities.
about.overview_sub: Bridging the urban-rural divide through youth empowerment and international cooperation.
about.overview_p1: Across many regions, rural areas face interconnected challenges...
about.overview_p2: The ROOT project responds to this reality...
about.mission_d: To empower rural youth with skills, knowledge, and networks that enable them to create meaningful change in their communities and build fulfilling lives close to their roots.
about.vision_d: A world where rural communities thrive, where young people see the countryside as a place of possibility...
about.matters_d: Rural decline affects many regions — socially, economically, and environmentally. By investing in rural youth, we invest in resilient communities, sustainable food systems, and a more balanced society.
about.target_sub: The people at the heart of ROOT.
about.impact_sub: The change we aim to create through ROOT.

about.impact_2: Strengthened capacity of youth organizations in partner countries
about.impact_3: Open-access educational resources available in multiple languages
about.impact_4: Cross-border network of rural youth change-makers
about.impact_5: Policy recommendations for sustainable rural development
about.impact_6: Replicable models for rural youth empowerment internationally
